selection: Whole v0.4.6 player overlay chrome for roadmap slice plr-overlay-and-controlbar-repin: overlay/BottomControlBar.kt, overlay/TopControlBar.kt, overlay/PlayerControlGlass.kt, overlay/PersistentProgressBar.kt, overlay/VideoProgressBarLayoutPolicy.kt, overlay/VideoPlayerOverlayContracts.kt, components/LandscapeDanmakuComposer.kt and the new components/PlainLandscapeDanmakuComposer.kt, plus the upstream tests VideoProgressBarLayoutPolicyTest.kt and PersistentProgressBarPolicyTest.kt.
purpose: Advance the vendored overlay used by Bangumi and the offline player to the complete v0.4.6 control bars through the producers that already own each file. The fullscreen-controls producer (tools/extract-upstream-video-player-full-controls.py) swaps its own predecessor of six files for the verbatim v0.4.6 bytes behind a hash assertion and emits the new Plain landscape composer with six counted, hash-pinned Windows adaptations (no Android window handle, the owned player dialog instead of Dialog); the render closure producer (tools/v037_player_render.py) does the same for PlayerControlGlass.kt. VideoPlayerOverlay.kt stays the complete v0.3.7 file and receives nine counted, hash-pinned hunks that only wire what the new bars need. The platform bindings and the NVIDIA slot that already existed run on the v0.4.6 bytes.

replacedDesktopTest.reason: The Windows copy pinned the v0.2.5 progress bar heights (20/32 ... 32/48 dp). v0.2.9 compacted them (12/28 ... 24/44 dp) and the upstream test was rewritten to assert layout invariants instead of literals; the Windows copy now holds the exact v0.4.6 upstream test.

behaviourChanges: BottomControlBar: fullscreen without liquid glass uses a plain landscape layout with play and pause, time, danmaku switch, settings and send in glass docks; with liquid glass the dock keeps the switch and shows send instead of settings; the inline time dock, 40 dp danmaku buttons, selection accent colours and adaptive plain dock spacing come with the file.
TopControlBar: the danmaku send action leaves the top bar; with liquid glass the top bar shows the danmaku settings button instead, and a title dock collapses to a circle when the slot is narrow.
PlayerControlGlass: docks stay elastic with component motion, force a dark media surface and white content colour.
Progress bars: 2 dp persistent bar and the seek bar use the selection accent; VideoProgressBarLayoutPolicy compacts the idle heights.

Overlay: the buffering circle waits for the first frame (defaults keep the old behaviour until a caller sets hasRenderedFirstFrame = false), the centre play control hides in plain fullscreen, and the fullscreen composer is the glass or the plain landscape composer.
notCarried: overlay/VideoPlayerOverlay.kt whole file: the v0.4.6 file calls landscapeEndDrawerPadding and landscapeControlCenterGroup and passes closeProgress and enableControlCenterMotion to LandscapeSidePanel (roadmap slice plr-control-center-motion) and passes coverUrl to PagesSelector (lst-episode-selector-collection). Nine counted hunks wire only what the carried bars need. Follow-up: re-pin the whole overlay after those two slices land and drop the follow-confirmation hunk of v046_follow_confirmation.py at the same time.

components/PiliPlusDanmakuSendIcon.kt (centred send glyph of v0.4.3): the v0.4.6 file imports appIconGlyphTextStyle from AppPrimitiveThemeDefaults, whose Windows copy is the v0.2.5 DIRECT file without that function. Follow-up together with the design-system theme defaults leaf.

ordinary video playback: VideoPlayerSection and the Windows leaf do not yet set VideoPlayerOverlayState.hasRenderedFirstFrame or suppressTransientOverlaysForTransition, so the first-frame gating of the buffering circle is dormant there (the contract defaults keep the previous behaviour).
OfflineVideoPlayerScreen and BangumiPlayerComponents progress-isolation hunks of f641eee3 (v034b1) and the PortraitTopBarLayoutPolicy change of ce406330 belong to the Bangumi and portrait slices.
The v0.3.9 glass dock hit-test above the native mpv canvas is unverified: Compose cannot draw above the heavyweight HWND, so the docks only render where the Compose layer is visible.
